settings.interpolation: linear TPOT upper bound between the adjacent measured points bracketing the SLO
settings.acceptance: one fast native run at the best layout's interpolated batch; falls back to the best measured passing point
settings.beyond_native_reach: largest measured point, marked limited, never extrapolated
settings.capacity: bypass KV capacity until a native point reaches it, then native capacity rejections; a KV rejection's reported native capacity batch is measured next
settings.import_speed: native_stationary_refill_not_always_ready is a too-big point; halving/bisection is reused and the limit is native_import_limited
settings.wall_projection: measured wall without the Prefill pass, as measured, against the per-worker 1800s projection; no concurrency divisor
